report:
I am sorry for your loss. All three have replied again. The list has changed. I added one point: C does not know of pressure. I have kept private details out of the shared list. I did not repeat points already on the list.

No one has the will wording yet. The will may rule out some options. The will must guide who owns the house and who gets sale money. I am not a lawyer and cannot interpret dad's will. An independent lawyer can explain ownership, shares, and approvals. I cannot decide ownership, shares, price, or timing. I cannot make legal decisions or move money.

The plan stands: find the will, get independent legal review, then use a neutral valuation and equal written terms if a sale is allowed. If no one can find a copy, an independent lawyer can explain what to do next. Please quote any words about age, twins, or younger exactly. Because A and C are twins, and B is younger, any age wording needs exact legal review. If it says "oldest" or "youngest", ask the lawyer how it applies to twins. Do not decide that among yourselves. No one should sign, pay, transfer, set a price, or make an offer before that review. This pause keeps options open.

This process keeps A's wish to buy on the table. It protects C from a discount she has not accepted. It gives B time to understand what money may be available. It does not set a price, decide shares, or promise money. A will check what she can and report back. B needs more time. I will keep the detail B marked private to myself. C will review the exact wording when it is found. Please tell me if you learn of a deadline, written offer, or pressure. If any part of your reply should stay private, please mark it. I will not share private details without permission. I will still put brief concerns in the shared list. Please reply even if you only say "I need more time". I will wait for replies that take longer. I will not treat silence as agreement.

I have kept the list in one place, at the end of each update. This final report includes the current list.

The current list is:
One. C: dad left the house in his will.
Two. C: A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount".
Three. C: C is not signing off on that.
Four. C: B could use some money too.
Five. C: C wants help sorting this out.
Six. C: C wants a fair financial share.
Seven. C: C has not agreed to a "family discount".
Eight. C: C will not subsidize a "family discount".
Nine. C: C may accept a sale to A at full market value if the will allows it.
10. C: No price or shares are settled.
11. C: C has no will wording to quote.
12. C: C does not know B's financial needs, offer details, or a deadline.
13. C: C wants this resolved but is not in a hurry.
14. A: A wants to buy the house with her husband on the ownership papers.
15. A: A has not set a price or made a written offer.
16. A: A wants a "family discount".
17. A: A may accept a neutral valuation and the same chance for B and C to buy at that price.
18. A: A cannot provide will wording right now.
19. A: A needs time to review the will and wants independent legal review before anyone signs.
20. B: B has no copy of the will and has not seen a written offer.
21. B: B only knows A wants to buy.
22. B: B is unsure what she wants for the house.
23. B: B wants to understand what money may be available.
24. B: B asked to keep one aim private.
25. B: B has no firm amount or date.
26. B: B is unsure whether she feels pressure.
27. B: B needs time to see the documents.
28. C: C will review the will when it is shared.
29. C: C knows of no deadline or written offer.
30. A: A has no copy of the will.
31. A: A does not know who holds the will.
32. A: A does not know of a deadline or written offer.
33. B: B does not know who holds the will.
34. B: B does not know of a deadline or written offer.
35. B: B wants one private detail kept private.
36. C: C has no copy of the will.
37. C: C does not know which lawyer wrote it.
38. C: C does not know where dad kept the will or who may have a copy.
39. C: C will review the wording when it is found.
40. A: A does not know how long the search may take.
41. A: A will check what she can and report back.
42. A: A does not know of pressure.

45. C: C does not know of pressure.
